description: Change a knowledge source: name, collection, language, tags, chunking (chunkStrategy auto|recursive|markdown|faq|rows, chunkSize 200-4000, chunkOverlap), contextual, vectorWeight/textWeight, mode rag|cag (cag = always in the agent's prompt). Saves a new config version; chunking changes re-index. Confirm to apply. Returns a proposal + confirmToken; call oma_confirm_tool next.

chunkOverlap.description: Characters carried over between chunks of one section

chunkStrategy.description: auto = structure-aware (headings, tables, FAQ, CSV rows)

contextual.description: Write a 1-2 sentence context for every chunk at ingest

mode.description: rag = searched per question, cag = always in the agent prompt

textWeight.description: Fusion weight of full text search (0-5)

name: oma_crew_knowledge_source_update
title: Update knowledge source
